text: Howard's sleeping. This is his mother. Why are you calling at this ungodly hour? Then call your own mother.

text: It was Sheldon. It's my own fault. I forgot the protocol we put in place after the great ear infection of 06.

text: I need soup. I tried to stop you.

text: You call Cuthbert Polly. We need to find a place to lay low for the next 18 to 24 hours.

text: Stand by. Mark, can my friends come over?

text: That's a negatory. But there's a Planet of the Apes marathon at the New Art today.

text: Five movies, two hours apiece. It's a start.

text: No, just crazy. Sheldon? What are you doing here?

text: I'm sick. Thank you very much.

text: You're a carrier. All these people here are doomed. You're doomed!
